EuroKids Campaign Highlights Lessons Children Teach Adults

EuroKids has launched a campaign titled '#UnexpectedTeachers' which aims to celebrate the lessons that children teach adults. The campaign focuses on the reciprocal nature of learning within families and educational settings.
